close_reason: Changed VirtualLocation.uri from Option<String> to String (mandatory per RFC 8984 §4.2.6); added 3 tests including uri_missing_fails_deserialization; 54 tests pass; clippy clean
description: RFC 8984 §4.2.6 defines VirtualLocation.uri as mandatory ('String', not 'String|null'). The crate models it as Option<String>, which would silently accept malformed VirtualLocation objects (no uri). Sub-objects are NOT subject to RFC 8620 partial-response suppression (that applies only to top-level JMAP object properties), so the Option<> rationale does not apply here. Fix: change to pub uri: String. Also add a test asserting that deserializing a VirtualLocation with no uri field fails or requires the field.
title: Fix VirtualLocation.uri: mandatory field should not be Option
